proof_audit.v13-c11-matching: Pass. Every pair is proposed at most once; acceptable holds only improve and never return to unmatched. A final blocking proposer must previously have been rejected. The first rejected achievable pair yields an earlier achievable rejection or a blocking pair in its witness stable matching. This proves proposer optimality, and strict comparisons give schedule independence. It does not compare a lie's changed stable set, so the separate incentive argument is necessary.
proof_audit.v13-c11-menu-proof: Pass. The alternating unmatched path continues by stability and individual rationality; a first repeated applicant contradicts either its initial unmatched status or injectivity at an earlier index. Swapping outcomes and sides proves the exact unmatched-set lemma. Reject-all IPDA deletes to a legal removed-agent run, so priorities determine a fixed menu including outside. A singleton preserves the full APDA outcome's stability; unmatched-set invariance and coupled first offers give menu inclusion. The strictly-above truncation replays the legal APDA prefix before the final partner, leaves the applicant exhausted and unmatched, and therefore leaves it unmatched in IPDA. A receiver's permanent matched status and coupling exclude every better menu offer. Thus each ordered-subset report selects its own best fixed-menu member, including empty and falsely acceptable reports. No strategy-proofness premise, group theorem or capacity result is used.
proof_audit.v13-c11-design-constraints: Pass. Both original stable sets are exhausted, not merely sampled. W2 forces D-W before checking all six remaining permutations and their four blocking witnesses. A recipient can improve by a different priority order; a one-name cap excludes the full truthful type. Neither is a counterexample to the fixed-environment applicant theorem. Menus can contain partners absent from true-profile stable outcomes.
proof_audit.v13-c11-assignment: Pass. Sum every allowed-edge inequality over an arbitrary partial assignment; nonnegative unused buyer utilities and object prices extend it to the full upper bound. Attainment requires all selected edges tight and unused terms zero. Original values, buyer endowments and seller ownership reconcile the cash and welfare accounts. Both restricted optimizers attain a certificate that deliberately omits the forbidden edge. No general supporting-price existence or fractional integrality theorem is claimed.
proof_audit.v13-c11-network-games: Pass. Completing the own-action square yields the full positive-part best reply. The absolute row sum bounds its sup-norm Lipschitz constant. A geometric sum makes every iteration coordinate Cauchy on the closed unbounded orthant; continuity gives existence and the strict contraction gives uniqueness. The zero bound and upper clipping are covered. Potential counts each undirected externality once, aggregate welfare twice. The positive quadratic remainder globally certifies the planner. Fees depend only on others' actions, can be collected from existing cash at every allowed profile and finance all subsidies before receipt; capped best replies implement the target uniquely. Participation losses are retained.
proof_audit.v13-c11-substitutes: Pass. The complementary path's positive replies reduce all equilibria to one exact denominator, yielding the true finite-existence threshold and showing that a failed sufficient row bound is inconclusive. A cap changes the action set and restores existence. In the substitute game every inactive/interior pattern is checked, including the singular gamma-one segment. The aggregate-square identity globally identifies the planner sets and shows why strict own concavity does not imply unique Nash equilibrium.
proof_audit.v13-c11-formation: Pass. All eight labeled graphs and each present deletion/absent addition are covered using both-weak/one-strict consent. Distance-two benefits survive triangle deletions and disappear on leaf separation. Comparing all four welfare architectures proves both efficiency thresholds, equality ties and the distinction between labeled and architectural uniqueness. Link-contingent transfers are specified in every deviation state and funded before benefits. They support the designated path but do not remove the negative aggregate first-edge surplus or make empty unstable.
proof_audit.v13-c11-evidence: Pass. The research critique distinguishes conditional model logic from identification, stability from welfare, simultaneous actions from exogenous spillovers, and policy implementation from selection or a formation path. Transfer enforceability, cash timing and changed report/action domains remain observable design requirements rather than assumed empirical conclusions.

On the changed cap-two domain the center and then both leaves are forced to two, proving the complete singleton equilibrium set.

At gamma one-half Nash welfare is 4/9 and every unit-sum pair is planner-optimal at 1/2. At one or two only the corners maximize welfare; the segment range is [1/4,1/2] and the gamma-two interior gives 1/9.
